module: "Road Network Import/Exporter" editor window (Window > Tech menu), visible only with a tech license (ResearchVerifier.isTechLicenseVerified()). It allows importing and exporting the Road Architect road network in OpenDRIVE (.xodr), OpenStreetMap (.osm) and SUMO (.nod.xml / .edg.xml) formats, with import options (placement, vertical offset, terraforming, domain of influence and margin) taken from Road Architect.
notes: Without a tech license, onEditorInitialized creates neither a window nor a menu entry and the other hooks return immediately.
The import goes through require() of the editor/roadArchitect/openDriveImport, osmImport and sumoImport modules (importFromFile(path, options)) inside a pcall; any error is displayed in the window.

The import options sent are: placeMode (0 = as in the file, 1 = custom X/Y, 2 = camera XY), placeX, placeY, offsetToTerrain, verticalOffset, terraform, domainOfInfluence (default 30), margin (default 1.0).
The export may temporarily pause the game during processing (warning displayed in the window).

onEditorInitialized.desc: Editor hook, called on initialization. Checks the tech license and, if valid, registers the window (600x600) and the "Road Network Import/Exporter" menu entry in the Tech group.

onEditorActivated.desc: Hook called when the editor is activated. Stores the current TerrainBlock (extensions.editor_terrainEditor.getTerrainBlock()). No effect without a tech license.

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every editor UI frame. Draws the window: import options, Import/Export table for OpenDRIVE, OpenStreetMap and SUMO, then the import result (imported/skipped roads, warnings).
